entries.title: Quantum acquisition HUD and simultaneous attack damage dice
changes: Added a CSS/JavaScript tactical acquisition HUD that follows each physical 3D die while it rolls, with rotating golden arcs, live pseudo-telemetry, crosshairs, scan sweeps and role labels.
Added a camera-aperture identification animation when Duality dice settle; the higher Hope or Fear die receives the locked outcome treatment after the scan completes.
Added a smooth probability-branch rejection state for the lower Duality interface without rerolling, removing or replacing either physical die.

Added a staged damage-vector shutdown for discarded damage dice, including HUD desaturation, quantum probability failure messaging and the existing renderer-backed darkening on the original settled mesh.
Weapon damage dice now join Hope and Fear in the initial attack roll. Only critical-only extra damage dice or rules-mandated Brutal rerolls are appended after the result is known.
Added a compact tactical solution panel summarizing WITH HOPE / WITH FEAR / CRITICAL and kept/discarded damage values.
Preserved Netlify production configuration, Firebase runtime configuration, Netlify Identity, local testing, books and canonical weapon data.

entries.title: Renderer-backed settled die glow and discard dimming
changes: Added a non-physical settled-mesh visual API to the local Dice Box renderer; it changes only Babylon presentation properties and never rolls, adds, removes or respawns dice.
The higher Hope or Fear die now receives a white renderer outline and white overlay directly on the original settled 3D mesh.
Critical Duality results apply the same renderer treatment to both original settled dice.
Discarded damage dice now receive an individual dark overlay, reduced visibility and gray instance colour on the original settled 3D mesh.
Added roll-index fallback matching so cues still target the correct die when a browser omits projected roll identifiers.
Strengthened screen-space glow/dimming only as a fallback while keeping Netlify, Firebase, local testing, books and canonical data unchanged.

entries.title: Settled 3D cues without extra dice
changes: Removed the physical winner-theme replacement that used DiceBox remove/add and could visibly throw the winning Duality die again.
Removed the physical discarded-theme replacement that could spawn a second gray die after the original damage dice had settled.
Added read-only settled-die screen projection and applies the white winner glow and gray DROP power-down as screen-space cues over the original dice.
Critical Duality rolls now illuminate both settled Hope and Fear dice individually without rerolling either die.
Removed the whole-canvas discard fade so only the discarded die is visually powered down.
Kept Netlify production, Firebase runtime configuration, local testing, books and canonical weapon data unchanged.

entries.title: Resolution-safe 3D overlay and Duality winner cues
changes: Resized the Dice Box world whenever Overlay mode, viewport size, or device orientation changes, preventing stretched or pixelated 3D rendering.
Added explicit WITH HOPE / WITH FEAR / CRITICAL outcome labels to the 3D HUD and DisplayResults panel.
Added a white glow to the winning Hope or Fear die in 2D callouts and DisplayResults after the dice settle.
Added per-theme winner-glow materials for Plain, Tech, and Crystal dice and attempts to replace the higher physical 3D die with the matching luminous material.
Preserved critical ties as a glow on both Duality dice and kept production/local Firebase behavior unchanged.

entries.title: Production-safe local test server
changes: Added a dependency-free local Node server that serves the portal and emulates the existing /api/firebase-config endpoint from local/.env.local.
Kept the production Netlify Function and Firebase environment-variable flow unchanged.
Added an explicit local runtime flag so Keeper and Admin role bypasses are available only through the bundled local server, never on Netlify.
Added Windows, macOS/Linux and LAN launchers plus local testing documentation and a private environment template.
Clarified that Netlify Identity, account vault writes and Netlify Forms remain online-only while all local-first tools and Firebase tables can be tested locally.

entries.title: Mobile options escape hotfix
changes: Rebuilt Player Tool Options as a mobile-safe full-height dialog with its own scroll region.
Added an always-visible Close control in the Options header and a persistent Back to Player Tool action in the footer.
Added Escape-key closing and body scroll locking while Options is open.
Added safe-area padding for phones with notches and home indicators.
Raised Options above the canonical navigation and other application layers.

entries.title: Dice themes, critical glow, gray discard and log controls
changes: Added Plain, Tech and Crystal 3D dice theme options.
Rebuilt Tech atlases so the technological texture is clearly visible.
Changed textured Fear dice numerals to white.
Added critical glow to Hope and Fear dice in 2D callouts and the 3D stage.
Added gray-off replacement for discarded dice in the 3D scene and result display.
Raised Roll History above portal navigation and kept Reset / Close controls sticky and visible.
Added an optional full-interface 3D overlay stage so physical dice can roll over a transparent layer above the Player Tool, while retaining the boxed 3D and standard 2D modes.
Added selectable Tech and Biolum 3D dice material families in Setup, with golden Hope, violet Fear, red Damage, and a gray switched-off visual language for discarded results.

Restored the simulated rolling animation inside every callout independently of the physical 3D renderer; Massive and other discarded dice now settle first and then fade smoothly to gray with explicit KEEP and DROP cues.
Removed the six-callout cap: Player Tool now keeps one current callout per rolling player or character and lays out all active callouts responsively.
Added explicit Reset and Close controls to Roll History; Reset clears the table log, active callouts and local Time Travel snapshots through a VeilFarers confirmation dialog.
Raised the 3D stage to the application top layer and made its HUD and results panels 80 percent transparent so interface banners cannot obscure dice or results.

Restored the missing normalizeSessionKey helper in Player Tool, fixing table connection, history clearing, autosave and shared roll writes.

Updated the Dice Box integration to the v1.1 config-object API and forced the stable onscreen renderer for broader browser compatibility.
Hardened 3D result parsing for both flat die-result arrays and grouped result objects, preserving Hope, Fear, Damage and Resolve role order.
